rationale: Records the fixes for the five findings the rebased review round left open (CR-001, CR-002, CR-003, CR-007, CR-008); all five are resolved at HEAD. CR-007 was the only code defect: the workflow model change had stopped marking the form dirty, so the panel could close without the unsaved-changes prompt; it now goes through the field onChange, and a new test fails if the fix is reverted (verified by mutation). CR-001 was a commit subject without the ticket prefix, reworded. CR-002, CR-003 and CR-008 were test gaps, now covered by three EditAssistantPage PUT-body tests and two VirtualAssistantForm tests, with the self-registering effort assertion in visualEditorFieldRegistry.test.ts reverted. Verification was the host suites for the touched areas (157 files, 1572 tests) plus typecheck and eslint; the test-harness run in the MR description predates these commits. Five further candidates from that round (CR-004, CR-005, CR-006, CR-009, CR-010) were dismissed with reasons rather than patched: the backend already drops unsupported temperature/top_p and clamps effort, main already nulls a top_p of 0, the backend contract fixes the capability shape, the lookup mirrors the pre-existing temperatureConstraints pattern, and the positional warning level is the behaviour the earlier round asked for.

standards_review.notes: All 9 subjects match the documented 'EPMCDME-13335: Capital sentence' format from .ai-run/guides/standards/git-workflow.md: capitalized first word, no trailing period, correct ticket prefix.
No code-quality guide exists at .ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md (confirmed absent) and no code_quality ArtifactRef was passed; absent standard, not a gap.

Checked 19 changed files against security-patterns.md (HTML sinks, redirects, cross-window messages, config/secrets). No dangerouslySetInnerHTML, untrusted redirects, postMessage, or new secret usage.
